{{Short description|Israeli military officer}}
'''Ofir Shoham''' ({{Langx|he|אופיר שוהם}}; born 1963) is a former brigadier general in the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] reserves, who served as Head of the [[Directorate of Defence Research & Development|Directorate of Defense Research and Development]], Weapons and Technological Infrastructure ('''Maf'at''' (מפא"ת) in the [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Ministry of Defense]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-09-02 |title=Ofir Shoham, Head of MAFAT, Retires After 6 Years {{!}} Israel Defense |url=https://www.israeldefense.co.il/index.php/en/node/24986 |access-date=2024-09-13 |website=www.israeldefense.co.il |language=en}}</ref>

== Military career ==
Shoham enlisted in the IDF in 1980 and is a graduate of the second cycle of the [[Talpiot program|Talpiot]] program, an elite IDF training program for recruits who have demonstrated outstanding academic ability in the sciences and leadership potential, in which he studied for a BA in mathematics and applied physics. He also completed an MA in applied physics.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pfeffer |first=Anshel |date=Apr 11, 2011 |title=Head to Head Expert Ofir Shoham, Does Iron Dome's Early Success Give the Public a False Impression? |url=https://www.haaretz.com/2011-04-11/ty-article/head-to-head-expert-ofir-shoham-does-iron-domes-early-success-give-the-public-a-false-impression/0000017f-e4be-d38f-a57f-e6febfbd0000 |website=Haaretz}}</ref>

From 1989 to 1993, he participated in an operational course in the [[Israeli Navy]], which included a captain's course. He carried out command and training positions, and served as commander of the warship [[INS Atzmaut|INS ''Atzmaut'']].

In 1994, he was appointed Head of the Detection and Optronics Branch (גל"א) at Navy Headquarters. In 1995, he was appointed Head of the [[Electronic warfare|Electronic Warfare]] Division (מל"א). In 1997, he was appointed Head of the Electronic Systems and Electronic Warfare (מל"א) Unit at Maf'at, with the rank of colonel. In 2000, he was appointed Head of the Budget and Economics Department at Navy Headquarters.

In June 2002, Shoham was promoted to brigadier general and appointed Assistant Head of the Planning Division. This made him the highest ranking Talpiot graduate since its founding.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Inside the IDF's Super-Secret Elite Brain Trust |url=https://www.thetower.org/article/inside-the-idfs-super-secret-elite-brain-trust-talpiot/ |access-date=2024-09-13 |website=The Tower |language=en-US}}</ref> He then served as commander of the [[Lotem Unit]] in the [[Computer Service Directorate]] from 2005 to 2010.

In March 2010, he was appointed Head of [[Directorate of Defence Research & Development|Maf'at]] and served in this position until June 2016.<ref>{{cite news |last=Gross |first=Judah Ari |last2=Staff |first2=ToI |title=Senior official in missile development program quits post |url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/senior-official-in-missile-development-program-quits-post/ |access-date=2024-12-16 |website=[[The Times of Israel]] |language=en-US |issn=0040-7909}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-02-24 |title=Comment: Slashed US funding for missile defense systems threatens Israel's security |url=https://www.jpost.com/opinion/comment-slashed-us-funding-for-missile-defense-systems-threatens-israels-security-445926 |access-date=2024-12-16 |website=[[The Jerusalem Post]] |language=en |issn=0792-822X}}</ref>
